analysis.recommended_tactic: For White Crappie, locate fish around submerged brush, timber or other available cover; present small jigs or minnows at or just above their depth. For Largemouth Bass, work remaining submerged cover and secondary points with jigs, Texas rigs or baitfish imitations; check feeding areas next to cover or breaks during this overnight period. For Saugeye, check riprap, points and breaklines with jig-and-minnow rigs or crankbaits, especially in low light; check feeding areas next to cover or breaks during this overnight period. Pool is 1.2 ft below normal with little measured change (-0.06 ft in 24 hours); check remaining submerged cover, forage and depth transitions.
analysis.analysis_commentary: Start on channel edges and remaining submerged cover near bait. At night, check feeding areas beside cover and match your presentation to the depth of the fish. If the area is empty, move to the next cover or break holding bait.
analysis.special_regulations: Daily/Size Limits: Striped bass and/or striped bass hybrids: five combined per day, of which only two may be 20 inches or longer. Additional Restrictions: Walk-in fishing is allowed year-round on the Arcadia Lake shoreline within the conservation area. Fishing is not allowed on the ponds or wetland areas.

lake_alerts.source_name: City of Edmond Current Public and Capital Improvement Projects
lake_alerts.summary: This project adds 1.8 miles of trail beginning at Midwest Blvd and links to the Spring Creek Trail via a low-water crossing. The contractor continues to make progress and is on track for completing the construction in the Fall.

lake_alerts.source_name: City of Edmond Current Public and Capital Improvement Projects
lake_alerts.summary: This project is needed to move raw water from Arcadia Lake Intake to the new Water Treatment Plant and to send treated water from the new Water Treatment Plant to the entire City of Edmond. The raw water lines from the Intake will be corrosion-resistant 48” HDPE and the Treated water transmission lines will be 36” fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) pipe from the Water Plant to I-35 and the 2 nd Street area. The contractor has installed over 7,100 Linear Feet (LF) of the 8,160 LF of 48-inch raw water transmission main. The contractor has installed 1,200 LF of the 18,230 LF of 36-inch water transmission main. The design of the realignment adjustments was completed and the associated change order was approved in October 2025. . The contractor restarted installation of the 36-inch FRP water transmission main following fabrication and delivery. Pipe installation is currently underway. The Contractor has recently completed pipe installation and is rehabilitating pavement along Saints Blvd. Installation of the new utility bridge across the Deep Fork has commenced; the Contractor has placed piers and is currently working on bridge abutments and slab foundations. The utility bridge will also serve as a pedestrian bridge for mountain bikers and pedestrian users of the trails in the area.

lake_alerts.project_name: Spring Creek Trail - Creek Bend Phase II
lake_alerts.source_name: City of Edmond Current Public and Capital Improvement Projects
lake_alerts.summary: This project will connect the two ends of the trail constructed as part of Phase I between Coltrane Rd and I-35. Once completed, the Spring Creek Trail would then run continuously from Spring Creek Park at Arcadia Lake to Coltrane Rd via an underpass below I-35. City staff have completed the land acquisition for the remainder of Phase II. Difficulties with obtaining land and/or easements, along with grant expenditure requirements resulted in the project being broken into two phases. The design of Phase II is at approximately 60%, but will now progress further since the land acquisition is finalized. No further update as of July 2026.

analysis.recommended_tactic: For White Bass, locate bait schools near points and humps, then match their depth with small swimbaits or spoons. For White Crappie, locate fish around submerged brush, timber or other available cover; present small jigs or minnows at or just above their depth. For Striped Hybrid Bass, locate open-water bait schools and channel edges, then match their depth with shad, swimbaits or spoons. Pool is 6.5 ft below normal with little measured change (+0.01 ft in 24 hours); check remaining submerged cover, forage and depth transitions.
analysis.analysis_commentary: Start on channel edges and remaining submerged cover near bait. At night, check feeding areas beside cover and match your presentation to the depth of the fish. If the area is empty, move to the next cover or break holding bait.
analysis.special_regulations: Methods: Allowed methods: up to three rods and reels per person with no more than three hooks per line (treble hooks are considered one hook). Bowfishing during daylight hours only. For all special regulations, visit https://www.okc.gov .
